<reason>B won by making the live comparison easier to decide: hosting justifies direct remedies, not an automatic insider queue; a reserve neither prices tickets nor stops resale inside the eligible group; and “or members” plus PRO’s insistence on the rule even without lockout showed overbreadth. A had a coherent civic-standing story and sharper rhetoric, but mostly restated first claim instead of justifying outsiders’ certain exclusion once buyer protections and need-based seats can also run before general sale.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s Rebuttal 2 after the pressure answers: PRO’s concession that a reserve is still required even when locals already get access undercut the lockout justification, and B showed PRO was crediting the reserve with affordability and purchase-limit work it does not do.</best_rebuttal>
